name: DeskDingo
author: DeskDingo

sections.description:
This plugin relies on a 3rd party service, DeskDingo. Your website’s visitors will see a chat widget on your website and messages sent between you and visitors will be collected and sent to DeskDingo, along with basic visitor behavior and traffic data. All data collected is used only to help you provide live chat support to your visitors. No data is sold or shared with any other 3rd party service.

You can review DeskDingo’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.faq:
Do I need a DeskDingo account?

Yes, you need to create an account at DeskDingo first.

Does it cost me money?

You can use the basic features for free.
